description: Client-side parser + React adapter for the agent-runtime output-block grammar (:::artifact, :::escalation, :::screener-result, :::audio-cue, :::suggestion). Maps parsed blocks onto SandboxWorkbenchArtifact[] for @tangle-network/sandbox-ui. Mandatory for any UI family that consumes agent-runtime sessions — sandbox-ui itself is transport-agnostic and ships no block parser. Ships in UI bundles (agent-with-ui-ts, orchestrator-with-ui-ts, sandbox-app-ts), not in agent-runtime bundles — the agent emits the text, the UI parses it.
